page_title: MON 2-1 MNT | Monaco v Montpellier 28/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' Marc Bollengier is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+8' 2 - 1 Goal! Lamine Camara (Monaco) volleys the ball from the edge of the box and it goes in off the right post. Breel Embolo provided the assist. 2:1.

90+7' Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom right corner, but Dimitry Bertaud shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
90+5' Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
90+2' RED CARD! Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) makes a bad challenge and receives a second yellow card from Marc Bollengier. He can have an early bath.
90' 8 additional min. will be played.
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Akor Adams leaves the pitch and Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) comes on.
88' Lamine Camara (Monaco) has tested the patience of referee Marc Bollengier and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
87' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

86' Dimitry Bertaud pulls off a great save to deny Lamine Camara (Monaco) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far! Monaco have been awarded a corner kick.
84' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) unleashed a brilliant free kick from the edge of the box and hits the left post of the goal.
82' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Mohammed Salisu (Monaco).
81' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
80' Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
78' The referee allows time for a substitution. Vanderson will be replaced by Jordan Teze (Monaco).
78' Adi Hutter decides to make a substitution. Caio Henrique will be replaced by Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco).
78' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) sends a cross into the box, but Dimitry Bertaud comes off his line to gather the ball.
77' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Monaco.

75' A nice cross arrived in the box from the corner kick and found the head of Mohammed Salisu (Monaco). He steered the ball towards the left post, but one of the defenders is there to cover the goalkeeper and keep it out.
75' Caio Henrique (Monaco) prepares to take a corner kick.
74' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Arnaud Nordin walks off the pitch to be replaced by Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier).
72' A cross into the box from Folarin Balogun (Monaco) is cleared.
71' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) works the corner short.
69' Monaco take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rabby Nzingoula trots off the pitch and is replaced by Birama Toure (Montpellier).
67' Adi Hutter has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lamine Camara (Monaco) replacing Eliesse Ben Seghir.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and George Ilenikhena (Monaco) replaces Maghnes Akliouche.
66' Monaco have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
66' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) storms into the box to get on the end of a pass, but smashes his shot straight onto the left post. Unlucky!
64' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the left post.
63' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) serves up a nice cross, but Dimitry Bertaud punches the ball away.
61' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
60' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) commits a rough challenge and Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for a foul.
55' Akor Adams (Montpellier) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.
50' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
50' Vanderson (Monaco) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marc Bollengier had an easy-decision to make.
49' Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
47' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
46' Half-time substitution. Michel Der Zakarian decided to make a change. Falaye Sacko is replaced by Enzo Tchato (Montpellier).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+2' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
41' A corner kick by Montpellier is thwarted by the well prepared Philipp Kohn (Monaco).
38' Dangerous play by Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco). Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for a foul.

32' 1 - 1 A superb goal from great team play! Folarin Balogun (Monaco) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot inside the left post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
31' Marc Bollengier interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Modibo Sagnan (Montpellier).
28' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) picks up a sweet pass and fires one in from distance towards the bottom right corner, but Philipp Kohn is alert and makes a decent save.
25' Monaco are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
21' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Caio Henrique (Monaco), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
19' Close! Folarin Balogun (Monaco) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot narrowly over the bar.
16' 0 - 1 An excellent first touch by Rabby Nzingoula (Montpellier), who collects a splendid pass and from the edge of the box slams the ball into the top right corner!

14' Breel Embolo (Monaco) displays brilliant awareness inside the six-yard box and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header low into the middle of the target, but Dimitry Bertaud keeps the ball out.
12' Marc Bollengier shows a yellow card to Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) for his blatant foul.

8' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Marc Bollengier blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
7' Breel Embolo (Monaco) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies just over the crossbar.
4' The game has begun to heat up. Modibo Sagnan (Montpellier) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
3' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) commits a rough challenge and Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for an infringement.
1' This shall not pass! Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
1' The first half has just begun.
Monaco will kick the game off.
Marc Bollengier is the one to supervise the game today.
